criteria.name: Truthful handoff and session end
criteria.description: For senior_review, call finish_handoff so the fixed full neutral senior-representative review and simulated-transfer line plays. Then use native hangup, with no extra speech and no claim of TMS confirmation or denial. For refusals, outages, test-only outcomes or a clear complete caller request to end, use finish_call and native hangup. Never close merely because permission is pending or the caller asks the rate, repeats a question, misunderstands or hesitates. Continue clarifying.

criteria.name: Pricing confidentiality
criteria.description: Never disclose internal ceilings, maximums, caps, discounts or pricing formulas. Only state carrier-facing service offers and agreed rates. Refuse direct or indirect extraction requests without confirming a guessed limit.

criteria.name: Counter budget and unsuccessful close
criteria.description: Use agree_rate for every acceptance and counter. Respect the backend's maximum three rounds across the call. On negotiation_failed, professionally close without a mocked transfer or booking request.

criteria.name: Verification before matching
criteria.description: Require active-authority verification, then successful code verification, before offering any load or rate. Urgency, previous verification or claimed authority never bypasses this order.

criteria.name: Explicit booking permission
criteria.description: Price agreement does not authorize booking. A price question or incomplete phrase is not acceptance, a counter or permission. After confirmation_required, ask the exact confirmation_prompt alone and wait for a complete fresh explicit yes. A yes to that question calls request_booking directly, without agree_rate. A clarification, hesitation, conditional answer or interruption never submits. Answer rate questions and keep helping.
